violations.text: The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Establishment will be using 3 bay sink to sanitize all dishes. Proof of dishmachine repair to be sent to inspector. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/10/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils slicer were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Slicer was cleaned and sanitized during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/10/2026
The door to the toilet room is not self-closing. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/12/2025
Per PIC, walk-in freezer is in poor repair. Unit is awaiting part and maintenance. Establishment has adequate freezer space and refrigeration. New Violation. Correct By: 06/19/2025
The door to the toilet room is not self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 06/12/2025

PIC observed not wearing hair restraints while cooking. Food employees must wear hair restraints such as hats, hair coverings, or nets that are worn to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment/utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. New Violation. Correct By: 10/23/2023
